property_summary: For any actor who locks in a guess at block B, settle() must revert while block.number <= B (i.e., before the target block has passed); the mutant relaxes this to block.number >= B, so at block.number == B it succeeds instead of reverting, which breaks the rule.
change_summary: Replace the strict inequality check with `block.number >= guesses[msg.sender].block`, allowing settle to be called one block earlier (when the blockhash is still zero), changing revert/success timing and settlement outcome.
